mapper.select: SELECT category_id, category_name, parent_id, member_id, is_default, created_at FROM category WHERE category_id = #{categoryId}
SELECT category_id, category_name, parent_id, is_default FROM category WHERE is_default = 1 AND member_id IS NULL ORDER BY category_id

SELECT ck.category_id FROM category_keyword ck WHERE #{keyword} LIKE CONCAT('%', ck.keyword, '%') AND (ck.member_id IS NULL OR ck.member_id = #{memberId}) ORDER BY ck.priority DESC, CASE WHEN ck.member_id = #{memberId} THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, ck.keyword_id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO category_keyword ( category_id, keyword, priority, member_id ) VALUES ( #{categoryId}, #{keyword}, #{priority}, #{memberId} )
mapper.select: SELECT category_id FROM category WHERE category_name = #{categoryName} AND (member_id IS NULL OR member_id = #{memberId}) ORDER BY CASE WHEN member_id = #{memberId} THEN 1 ELSE 2 END LIMIT 1
